scenario_name: AwnNORA Guardian: private evidence intake to user-approved action draft
journey: Upload each PDF to POST /api/v1/guardian/evidence-documents with a unique Idempotency-Key.
The API validates the file signature, enforces a 5 MiB cap, stores bytes in a private local adapter and records SHA-256 provenance.
The document remains STORED_UNSCANNED; the demo supplies structured fields as USER_SUBMITTED_STRUCTURED_FIELDS and does not pretend OCR or model extraction occurred.
Submit the structured invoice to POST /api/v1/guardian/invoice-reviews with a separate Idempotency-Key.
The deterministic review checks line arithmetic, subtotal/total reconciliation, source-field evidence, confidence, duplicate file digest and comparable historical invoices.
Review the case through GET /api/v1/guardian/cases and draft a clarification letter through POST /api/v1/guardian/cases/{case_id}/draft.
The user may explicitly approve the draft via POST /api/v1/guardian/cases/{case_id}/approve-draft. This does not send it; provider delivery is not implemented.

expected_outcomes.current_bill: REVIEW_REQUIRED with UNUSUAL_INCREASE (INR 800.00 to INR 1180.00); a review signal, not proof of wrongdoing
expected_outcomes.action: Draft only; no external contact, complaint submission, cancellation or payment
